findings.statement: The registered primary family has eight continuous coordinates, but a generic STF2 plus STF3 carrier has dimension 5+7=12 and a generic SO(3) orbit has dimension 3, leaving a nine-dimensional quotient. Eight smooth real features have Jacobian rank at most eight and therefore cannot locally separate generic orbits. The report must call the family a generically incomplete eight-feature subset, not merely say that global completeness is unproven.

issue_dispositions.wu008_power_objection: Not closed. Even absent the convention defect, WU-008 measures conditional power for five algebraic alternatives under a 200-reference functional, not power of the original 301/1000 observation tests or physical shear, vorticity, or Bianchi responses.
issue_dispositions.scalar_dependence_galactic_reporting: Scalar results, participation-ratio dependence diagnostics, and Galactic companion ranks are present. Hidden Galactic-basis dependence of the nominal frame-free base remains because of the critical convention defect.
